# Test: grove switch shell completion excludes current worktree
setup_workspace feature/auth develop

exec grove add feature/auth
exec grove add develop

cd $WORK/workspace/main
exec grove __complete switch ''
stdout 'feature-auth\tfeature/auth'
stdout '^feature/auth'
stdout 'develop'
! stdout '^main'
! stdout '^develop$'

exec grove __complete switch feature/
stdout '^feature/auth$'
! stdout 'feature-auth'

exec git worktree add --detach ../detached HEAD
exec grove __complete switch ''
stdout '^detached$'
! stdout '^detached\t'
